items.title: Sharkey Bonano Interview, 1966-11-09
items.q: He didn't know me, but he knew about me through a fellow by the name of Sidney Harriton. Oh yeah. You remember him? I never knew him.

ctx.x: So I got a contract to record for Brunswick, which held me over in New York. I didn't have nothing to worry about then, and then I got paid, you know, and I got a little royalty. So I stayed in New York, and Nick Rangetti, the place that I played in the village, he knew about me. He didn't know me, but he knew about me through a fellow by the name of Sidney Harriton. Oh yeah. You remember him? I never knew him. He had died before I got there.
